claim: The one-click demo uses sample data that stays separate from real records and can be reset.
where: landing action, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real record; enter demo; mutate and reset it; return to real data

claim: Work Receipt sends no work-session data, analytics, or tracking requests.
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; record all requests while editing a session and opening its receipt; allow same-origin only

claim: Saved work sessions remain in this browser after reload.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real work session; reload; assert its full outcome remains

claim: Saved work sessions open offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh demo context; wait for service-worker control; go offline; reload; assert sample work session and offline status

claim: A JSON backup exports and restores all work sessions.
sandbox: fresh context; create a work session; export and parse JSON; delete it; import the file; assert restoration

claim: CSV export contains one row for every work session.
sandbox: fresh demo context; download CSV; assert headers and three sample rows

claim: The weekly PDF lists outcomes, billable time, interruptions, and selected evidence.
sandbox: fresh demo context; assert receipt preview details; download a non-empty PDF

claim: Work Receipt provides an installable PWA manifest and service worker.
sandbox: fresh browser context; validate manifest fields and an active controlling service worker

claim: Recording, receipt details, weekly PDFs, backup, import, and CSV export are free with no paid tier.
sandbox: fresh browser context; verify all core controls are enabled and no checkout or license controls exist

claim: Every weekly receipt identifies itself as self-reported rather than independent proof.
where: hero caption, receipt preview, terms page, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; assert the receipt heading and disclaimer
